services.title: Complete dental care for every smile
services.subtitle: We work with the main specialties of dentistry so we can take care of everything your teeth, gums and mouth need.
services.braces.title: Braces & Invisalign
services.braces.description: Orthodontic treatment straightens and aligns your teeth. Unlike the metal braces of years ago, today there are modern, almost invisible options that get the same results.
services.implants.title: Dental Implants
services.implants.description: A fixed, non-invasive solution that does not affect your other teeth, with a success rate of around 97% and very simple hygiene.
services.whitening.title: Teeth Whitening
services.whitening.description: Professional whitening performed in our office, because a bright white smile is a beautiful smile.
services.endodontics.title: Endodontics
services.endodontics.description: When a strong infection attacks a tooth, our endodontists stop it, clean it out and protect the tooth with a crown so you keep it for years to come.
services.dentures.title: Dentures
services.dentures.description: Partial and complete dentures made to measure from durable materials, so you can smile and eat comfortably again.
services.crowns.title: Crowns
services.crowns.description: Custom crowns that restore and protect damaged or root-treated teeth, shaped and shaded to match your natural smile.
services.maxillofacial.title: Maxillofacial
services.maxillofacial.description: Surgical care for the mouth, jaw and face — from wisdom teeth to corrective jaw treatment, handled by our specialists.
services.pediatric.title: Pediatric Dentist
services.pediatric.description: Gentle, friendly dentistry for children: first check-ups, sealants and cavity prevention in a calm, welcoming setting.
about.title: Your smile is our goal
about.lead: Hundreds of happy patients have trusted us to build a healthy, beautiful smile.
about.body: The experience of all our dentists and qualified staff means you leave satisfied after every treatment. You do not have to go to the border for work that comes with no guarantee — here you get good prices, excellent quality in every service and friendly care at prices that fit your budget.
about.bodySecond: We cover the main specialties of dentistry so we can attend to every need of your teeth, gums and mouth. Trust us — we will not let you down.

testimonials.title: Real patients, real smiles
testimonials.subtitle: Quotes from verified patient reviews of our Los Angeles clinic.
testimonials.imageAlt: Happy patient smiling with braces at Happy Smiles
testimonial.one.quote: I had an accident and lost several teeth. The prices other dentists gave me were unattainable, but the Happy Smiles doctors suggested dental implants and they left my teeth the way I had them before. I thought I would never smile again — thanks to God and the Happy Smiles doctors, I smiled again.
testimonial.one.name: Rosamaria Castro
testimonial.two.quote: The staff is incredibly welcoming, professional and knowledgeable. Every visit is comfortable and I always feel well taken care of. I highly recommend them.
testimonial.two.name: Verified patient
testimonial.three.quote: Very professional, the staff is amazing and made me feel very welcome. I'm definitely coming back in two weeks for the rest of my treatment.
testimonial.three.name: Verified patient
